title: DSWD pours P884.7M in aid to sugarcane farmers, laborers in Negros

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) has released P884,778,900 under its disaster assistance program to support sugarcane farmers and laborers affected by red-striped soft-scale insect (RSSI) pest infestations in Negros Island. The amount released was as of Monday, Nov. 2. The Negros-wide financial relief distribution has reached 86,092 beneficiaries comprising 64,042 farmers and 22,050 agricultural laborers to help mitigate losses caused by pest damage to sugarcane crops, DSWD Negros Island Region Director Arwin Razo said on Wednesday.
